meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents… “HP 16W Seadawg” at High Pointe Resort, your perfect Seacrest Beach retreat! Start your mornings with calming ocean breezes and embrace laid-back luxury. This ground-floor corner condo offers breathtaking views, access to a resort-style pool
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “HP 16W Seadawg” at High Pointe Resort, your perfect Seacrest Beach retreat! Start your mornings with calming ocean breezes and embrace laid-back luxury. This ground-floor corner condo offers breathtaking views, access to a resort-style pool, and peaceful walks to the private beach. Enjoy tennis, pickleball, and sunset drinks at Crabby Steve’s, all while surrounded by coastal beauty. Experience ultimate relaxation and create unforgettable memories. Ready to escape? Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Corner Ground-Floor Gulf-Front Condo with Panoramic Beach Views – Wake up to breathtaking, unobstructed vistas of the sparkling Gulf, right from your private retreat.Expansive Community Pool with Waterfalls and Hot Tub – Dive into a tropical paradise with a resort-style pool, complete with serene cascading waterfalls and a relaxing hot tub to unwind.Seasonal Beach Chair Setup (2 Chairs + Umbrella) – Enjoy effortless beach days with your own reserved setup, perfect for soaking up the sun and catching the ocean breeze.Steps to Crabby Steve’s Private Beach Bar and Nearby Shopping/Dining at Peddlers Pavilion – Savor the laid-back coastal vibe with delicious drinks, beachfront dining, and boutique shopping just a short stroll away.Tennis & Pickleball Courts + Playground for Kids – Stay active and entertained with sports facilities for all ages and a fun playground to keep the little ones happy.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"The beach chair setup was fantastic, the location couldn’t have been better, and the condo was spacious and beautifully maintained. Highly recommend!" – Trummie⭐"The view was absolutely breathtaking, and the short walk to the beach made it so convenient. Plus, the beds were incredibly comfortable—like sleeping on a cloud!" – Jackie⭐"Everything about this condo was perfect—from the location to the amenities. It truly felt like a home away from home. Thank you for an amazing stay!" – Amberly*** LIVING AREA ***Relax and unwind in the expansive open-concept living room, beautifully designed with a breezy coastal chic aesthetic. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the space with natural light while offering stunning Gulf views, creating an idyllic retreat to recharge after a sun-soaked day at the beach. Sink into the plush, comfortable seating as you enjoy the flat-screen TV and immersive surround sound, perfect for family movie nights or peaceful evenings spent in total relaxation.Luxurious sofa and armchairs perfectly positioned to enjoy breathtaking Gulf-front viewsHigh-definition flat-screen TV with a DVD player and immersive surround sound for ultimate entertainmentStep directly onto your private patio featuring elegant outdoor seating for relaxation or alfresco dining*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The fully-equipped kitchen is a perfect blend of style and functionality, featuring luxurious granite countertops and plenty of workspace to bring your culinary creations to life. Whether you're crafting gourmet meals or preparing quick beachside snacks, this kitchen has you covered. The dining room offers a picturesque setting to enjoy family meals, complete with breathtaking, uninterrupted views of the Gulf that make every bite even more memorable.Sleek granite countertops paired with modern stainless steel appliances for a stylish, functional kitchenSpacious dining table comfortably seats 6, complemented by 3 additional barstools at the kitchen bar for extra seatingFully stocked kitchen with high-quality cookware, elegant dinnerware, and all the essentials you need to dine and entertain with ease*** BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ***Primary King Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, stunning Gulf views and En-suite with dual vanities, oversized garden tub and walk-in shower.Queen Guest Suite: Queen Bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower.Twin Guest Suite: 2 Twin Beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower.*** HIGH POINTE RESORT OVERVIEW ***Step outside and immerse yourself in the vibrant offerings of High Pointe Resort. From the expansive lagoon-style community pool surrounded by lush landscaping to the direct boardwalk to the beach, the outdoor amenities make every day feel like a vacation.Exclusive Gulf Side Resort in a Gated Community in Seacrest Beach.Expansive Pool Deck Featuring a large Pool, Serene Waterfall, Kiddie Pool, and Relaxing Hot TubBeach Front Bar and Grill – Crabby Steve’s, Serving Delicious Meals with Stunning Ocean ViewsExclusive Private Beach Boardwalk for Convenience and PrivacyAmenity-rich 15-Acre Tropical Paradise Perfect for Families and Beach EnthusiastsWell-Maintained Tennis Court and Four Pickleball Courts for Sports LoversChildren's Playground for the Little OnesShuffleboard Court for Family FunBBQ Grills - Charcoal for Outdoor Dining*** LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ***Nestled in the heart of 30A, this unit provides the perfect blend of convenience and charm. Enjoy effortless access to nearby attractions like the picturesque Rosemary Beach or relax in the serenity of the private beach just steps away. With everything you need within walking distance, “HP 16W Seadawg” is your gateway to unforgettable coastal adventures.Peddlers Pavilion (Right Across the Street) – A lively gathering place, offering a diverse selection of vendors that appeal to both locals and tourists, complemented by live music on most summer evenings.Rosemary Beach (6 min walk) – Cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a relaxed vibe.Alys Beach (0.9 mile) – Elegant architecture and serene atmosphere.Carillon Downtown & Market Street (8-minute drive) – a vibrant hub for shopping and dining.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Bicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce Vita.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.This property has 1 included beach set-up available 3/6 to 10/31, featuring 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 207716
